meta.philosophy: Detrained body in a calorie deficit on a GLP-1 drug: the job is holding onto muscle while the scale drops, not chasing numbers. Three full-body sessions, any order, any three days, each one hits everything so a missed or reordered day never breaks the program. Machines and cables over free weights because he trains alone and needs to walk up to a labeled machine and know exactly what to do with it.

rampIn.rule: Weeks 1 and 2 use rampSets instead of the listed sets (usually 2 instead of 3) and RPE stays at 5-6, meaning stop with 4-5 reps left in the tank, not 2-3. Same exercises, same order, just less volume and no grinding reps, so soreness stays mild enough that he actually shows up for session 2 and 3.

exercises.name: Life Fitness Insignia Series Chest Press
exercises.machine: Pin-loaded machine line, mid floor
exercises.cue: Set the seat so the handles line up mid-chest before picking a weight, not after.
exercises.swap: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Bench Press in the plate-loaded zone.

exercises.name: Life Fitness Insignia Series Seated Leg Press (Arc Leg Press)
exercises.machine: Leg section of the pin-loaded machine line
exercises.cue: Feet shoulder-width on the plate, stop the knees short of locking out at the top.
exercises.swap: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Press, plate-loaded leg zone.

exercises.name: Life Fitness Insignia Series Seated Row
exercises.machine: Next to the pulldown machine in the selectorized section
exercises.cue: Chest stays pinned to the pad the whole set, pull with the shoulder blades not the arms.
exercises.swap: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Row, chest-supported plate-loaded unit.

exercises.name: Life Fitness Insignia Series Shoulder Press
exercises.machine: Upper body end of the pin-loaded machine line
exercises.cue: Handles start at shoulder height, press straight up without banging the elbows into lockout.
exercises.swap: Smith Machine standing press, safety pins set below rack height.

exercises.name: Life Fitness Insignia Series Leg Curl (seated or prone)
exercises.machine: Leg section, usually beside leg extension
exercises.cue: Pad sits just above the heel, don't let the lower back arch off the seat to cheat the rep.
exercises.swap: Cable crossover with an ankle strap, single-leg curl.

exercises.name: Life Fitness Insignia Series Triceps Press
exercises.machine: Upper body end of the pin-loaded machine line
exercises.cue: Keep the elbows tucked to the sides, only the forearm should move.
exercises.swap: Cable crossover tricep pressdown, rope or straight bar attachment.

exercises.name: Adjustable Cable Crossover core / rope crunch
exercises.machine: Dual-tower cable station, central strength zone
exercises.cue: Kneel below the pulley, curl the ribs toward the hips, don't just pull with the arms.
exercises.swap: Plank hold, 3 x 30 seconds, on the free-weight mats.

exercises.name: Life Fitness Insignia Series Pulldown
exercises.machine: Pin-loaded machine line, beside the seated row
exercises.cue: Lock the thigh pads down first, pull the bar to the upper chest, don't lean back to finish the rep.
exercises.swap: Adjustable Cable Crossover with a wide bar attachment, kneeling pulldown.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Press
exercises.machine: Plate-loaded leg zone
exercises.cue: Load both sides evenly and control the negative, this one moves independently per leg.
exercises.swap: Life Fitness Insignia Series Seated Leg Press, selectorized leg section.

exercises.name: Life Fitness Signature Series Chest Press (cable/functional trainer)
exercises.machine: Cable/functional-trainer wall, dual-adjustable-pulley station
exercises.cue: Set both pulleys at chest height and press forward without letting the shoulders round.
exercises.swap: Life Fitness Insignia Series Chest Press, selectorized row.

exercises.name: Life Fitness Insignia Series Leg Extension
exercises.machine: Leg section, next to leg curl
exercises.cue: Pad rests on the shins above the ankle, back stays flat against the pad, no jerking the weight up.
exercises.swap: Smith Machine goblet-style split squat, light load.

exercises.name: Adjustable Cable Crossover face pull / rear delt row
exercises.machine: Dual-tower cable station, central strength zone
exercises.cue: Set the pulley at face height, pull the rope apart toward the ears, elbows stay high.
exercises.swap: Life Fitness Insignia Series Seated Row, selectorized section.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl, rubber hex rack
exercises.machine: Free-weight floor, mirrored wall section
exercises.cue: Pick a weight you can control for all reps without swinging the torso.
exercises.swap: Adjustable Cable Crossover, low-pulley bicep curl.

exercises.name: Life Fitness Insignia Series Triceps Press
exercises.machine: Upper body end of the pin-loaded machine line
exercises.cue: Elbows tucked, full extension at the bottom without locking hard.
exercises.swap: Cable crossover tricep pressdown, rope attachment.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Plate-Loaded Iso-Lateral Bench Press
exercises.machine: Plate-loaded strength zone, near the free weights
exercises.cue: Load plates evenly on both sides and press each arm together, don't let one side lead.
exercises.swap: Life Fitness Insignia Series Chest Press, selectorized row.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Row
exercises.machine: Plate-loaded zone, chest-supported row unit
exercises.cue: Chest stays against the pad, pull each handle back independently and squeeze at the top.
exercises.swap: Life Fitness Insignia Series Seated Row, selectorized section.

exercises.name: Life Fitness Insignia Series Seated Leg Press (Arc Leg Press)
exercises.machine: Leg section of the pin-loaded machine line
exercises.cue: Feet shoulder-width on the plate, knees track over the toes, don't lock out.
exercises.swap: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Press, plate-loaded leg zone.

exercises.name: Smith Machine shoulder press
exercises.machine: Fixed vertical bar track along the free-weight wall
exercises.cue: Set the safety hooks below your lowest rep depth before loading the bar.
exercises.swap: Life Fitness Insignia Series Shoulder Press, selectorized row.

exercises.name: Life Fitness Insignia Series Leg Curl (seated or prone)
exercises.machine: Leg section, usually beside leg extension
exercises.cue: Pad just above the heel, keep the lower back flat instead of arching to move the weight.
exercises.swap: Life Fitness Insignia Series Leg Extension as a quad-only substitute.

exercises.name: Adjustable Cable Crossover pulldown
exercises.machine: Dual-tower cable station, central strength zone
exercises.cue: Set the pulley overhead, kneel or sit, pull to the upper chest without leaning back.
exercises.swap: Life Fitness Insignia Series Pulldown, selectorized row.

exercises.name: Adjustable Cable Crossover woodchop (core)
exercises.machine: Dual-tower cable station, central strength zone
exercises.cue: Rotate from the hips and ribs together, keep the arms relatively straight, don't just yank with the shoulders.
exercises.swap: Plank hold, 3 x 30 seconds, on the free-weight mats.
